name: Directional curvature
mathematical_definition: At middle stored state yk, v=ones(n)/sqrt(n), h=1e-3*max(1,||yk||2). D_h=[g(y+h v)-2g(y)+g(y-h v)]/h^2. Return ||D_(h/2)||2, ||D_h-D_(h/2)||2 and h.
units: scaled RHS per squared scaled-state displacement
